title: TradeWith Bulk Buyer Import
description: The request body scripts/export_leads.py writes for TradeWith's admin buyer bulk import: exactly {"buyers": [row, ...]}, each row a BulkBuyerRowDto (tradewith-api BulkImportDto) MINUS every field this package must never fill. contactName, contactEmail, contactPhone, notes, extraNotes, qualityTierLabel and hsCodes are absent from `properties`, so additionalProperties:false forbids them structurally - no contact field is ever sent, not even a company role mailbox, because TradeWith marks a row with an email as a high-confidence contact and a re-import would overwrite an address an admin corrected. It is an EXPORT document: no scorer reads it and producing one never changes a score. The --format tradewith-csv rows are validated against the same shape. See references/data-contract.md section 9.6. Korean gloss: TradeWith 관리자 바이어 일괄 등록 요청 본문.

text.description: A real value: never empty, never whitespace only, never the literal unknown. An omitted key leaves the stored TradeWith value alone; an explicit value overwrites it.

sourceId.description: kbtm:<canonical_domain without www.>, or kbtm:id:<buyer_id> when the domain is unknown. The domain is the merge key and survives dedupe survivor-id churn, so a re-import updates the same TradeWith row; the kbtm: prefix keeps these ids apart from every other CSV import.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. A record whose country is unknown is skipped, never sent.

social.description: A LinkedIn organisation page (/company/, /showcase/ or /school/ plus a name; no empty, . or .. segment, percent-encoded dots included, and no userinfo). A member profile is never sent: matching shows this field to sellers unmasked.
